function_purpose: Receive ego speed, target distance, relative speed, road friction, and actuator delay.
Prepare scenario variables for the concept-level verification model.
Estimate whether the vehicle can stop safely under the given road and delay assumptions.
Estimate collision urgency using distance and closing-speed information.
Classify the situation into SAFE, CAUTION, WARNING, or EMERGENCY BRAKE.
Generate a binary brake-request output when the risk condition becomes critical.
Compare actual outputs with expected scenario outputs and store verification evidence.
